prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Noor Halden for the job below.

About the freelancer: 6 years experience; skills: Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, machine learning

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Machine learning engineer for NLP embedding models
Purpose; A generally repurposable Transformer model, used to create embedding of rich text data such as reviews, biographies and short form content of up to 2gb of training data. There are three components to the model: 1/ Clustering multiple text features into discrete groups 2/ Ability for the model to generate similarity cosine scores for each cluster with a input text (i.e search query) 3/ Infrastructure development to support deployment, scheduling and running of the model if GPUs are required to allow for scalability Scalability and speed are important as we intend to use the model for real-time applications as a result the model needs to run on GPUs and can easily be increased if there is a need for larger training sets. You would be required to write the code, deploy the code on infrastructure that can be run GPUs (we don’t have a preference for the specific cloud service to utilise, recommendations are welcome) Example use cases: For example we want to cluster all the member of linkedin using their bio, job experience and recommendations into groups of similar members. When we add an input of “Professions who are good at dancing and banking” the model can product a ranking of all the clusters ranked by the cosine distance Requirements Transformer model should have a maximum latency of 5 seconds for 20mb of input data. Python as the primary language (either tensorflow or Pytorch) The model should be capable of converting reviews, bios, and other text into cosine simil
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
(none)

Style:
- Open by restating the client's specific problem in one sentence.
- Do not mention any specific past project or client.
- Keep it under 150 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
You need a Python-based Transformer NLP system that can cluster rich text into discrete groups, score cluster similarity against input queries with cosine distance, and run on scalable GPU infrastructure with low latency.

I’m Noor Halden, a machine learning engineer with 6 years of experience in Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning. I can build the embedding and clustering pipeline, implement similarity scoring for search-style ranking, and support deployment on GPU-ready infrastructure with scalability in mind.

I’d focus on a design that is efficient for large text volumes, practical for real-time use, and structured so it can be expanded as training data grows. If you’d like, I can help shape the modeling approach, implementation plan, and deployment strategy for the best balance of speed and quality.
